infobox.trader: Prapor LL3, after completing his task Our Own Land/Ironclad Proof

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.
- When fired, is added to the shooter for 7 seconds, causing tinnitus and muffled audio
- When fired, shooter-facing entities in a 160° cone in front of the barrel receive for 20 seconds, causing a blinding effect that starts to fade out after 10 seconds, as well as a visual impairment which lasts 90 seconds
- Within a 10m radius around the shooter, is added to entities for 15 seconds, causing tinnitus and muffled audio
